message.content:
This is a CBP ruling on stainless steel PEX fittings. Stainless steel tube or pipe fittings fall under heading 7307. Subheading 7307.2 covers cast fittings, 7307.21 flanges, 7307.22 threaded elbows, bends and sleeves, 7307.23 butt welding fittings, and 7307.29 other. Fittings of stainless steel other than those are 7307.2x. The 7307.29.00 subheading breaks down as 7307.29.0030 (Other: Tube or pipe fittings, not cast) and so on, while 7307.2 applies to "Other, of stainless steel."

The statistical suffixes under 7307.29.00 are 30 for "Tube or pipe fittings not cast... " Actually, I recall that the 7307.23 and 7307.29 breakdowns are: 7307.23.0030 for butt welding fittings, and 7307.29.0030 for threaded elbows or sleeves, with 7307.29.0090 for other.

The ruling likely classified the fittings in 7307.29.0090. The plug and adapters are barbed, not threaded sleeves. The female and male adapters have threads, but they are not threaded elbows, bends or sleeves, so 7307.29 is appropriate. The 7307.29.0090 code covers other.

The 7307.22 subheading covers threaded elbows, bends and sleeves, and a coupling is arguably a sleeve, but the coupling here has barbs, not threads. So 7307.29.0090 fits.
